settings.label: Language
settings.description: The language of the program. Version 1 is in English (UK) only.

settings.label: Default start screen
settings.description: Which screen opens when the program starts: the case library, the case you worked on last, or the Academy.

settings.label: Open last case automatically
settings.description: Reopens your most recent unfinished attempt as soon as the program opens.

settings.label: Date format
settings.description: How dates are written across the program, such as 03/02/2026 or 2026-02-03.

settings.label: Time format
settings.description: Shows times on a 24 hour clock (18:42) or a 12 hour clock (6:42 pm).

settings.label: Time shown in evidence
settings.description: Whether evidence times appear as recorded by the device, corrected for a known clock offset, or both side by side.

settings.label: Week starts on
settings.description: The first day of the week in calendars, rotas and the timeline's day view.

settings.label: Number format
settings.description: How large numbers and decimals are written, for example 1,234.56 or 1 234,56.

settings.label: Currency display
settings.description: Shows money with a symbol (£180.00) or a code (GBP 180.00).

settings.label: Confirm before closing
settings.description: Asks before the program closes, so you do not lose your place by accident.

settings.label: Chosen name
settings.description: The name you picked on first launch. It appears on your profile badge and report sign-off. It is for show only.

settings.label: Avatar
settings.description: The small picture on your profile badge. Academy ranks and badges unlock extra frames.

settings.label: Badge style
settings.description: What the profile badge at the top shows: your name and avatar, just the name, or just the avatar.

settings.label: Show Academy rank on badge
settings.description: Adds your Academy rank, such as Junior Analyst, under your name on the badge.

settings.label: Name on report sign-off
settings.description: Puts your chosen name on the sign-off line of exported reports. It never changes the marks.

settings.label: Reset profile
settings.description: Clears your chosen name so the name choice appears again. Saves, settings and Academy progress are kept.
settings.note: Button. Returns to the name choice

settings.label: Theme
settings.description: The colour scheme: Light, Dark, High contrast, or Match my computer to follow your system setting.

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.description: The colour of buttons, links and highlights.

settings.label: Text size
settings.description: Makes all text in the program smaller or larger.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: The typeface. Dyslexia friendly uses a clearer, more spaced font. Monospace for data tables lines up columns of figures.

settings.label: Line spacing
settings.description: The space between lines of text. Relaxed can make long documents easier to read.

settings.label: Layout density
settings.description: How tightly lists, buttons and panels are packed. Compact shows more at once; Spacious is easier to click.

settings.label: Corner style
settings.description: Square or rounded corners on panels, cards and buttons.

settings.label: Icon style
settings.description: Outline or filled icons in menus and buttons.

settings.label: Panel arrangement
settings.description: Where the evidence list sits in the workspace: on the left, on the right, or with notes along the bottom.

settings.label: Remember panel sizes
settings.description: Keeps panel widths as you left them the next time you open a case.

settings.label: Interface zoom
settings.description: Scales the whole interface, from 75% to 200%.

settings.label: Tooltips
settings.description: Whether small explanations appear when you hover over buttons, and how quickly.

settings.label: Show status bar
settings.description: Shows a thin bar at the bottom with save status, the stage and the number of items.

settings.label: Reduce motion
settings.description: Shortens or removes animations, including Academy effects and screen transitions.

settings.label: Reduce transparency
settings.description: Replaces see-through backgrounds with solid colours.

settings.label: High contrast evidence viewers
settings.description: Uses stronger contrast inside documents, tables and emails, even when the rest of the theme is normal.

settings.label: Colour blind safe palette
settings.description: Swaps colours that are hard to tell apart for a palette suited to your type of colour vision. Labels always show as text too.

settings.label: Focus outline thickness
settings.description: How thick the outline is around whatever the keyboard is focused on.

settings.label: Large click targets
settings.description: Makes buttons and list rows bigger and easier to hit.

settings.label: Underline links
settings.description: Underlines every link, not only on hover.

settings.label: Strengthen graph and timeline lines
settings.description: Draws thicker lines and borders in the link chart, timeline and map.

settings.label: Reading ruler
settings.description: Shows a soft band that follows your pointer, to help keep your place in long text.

settings.label: Screen reader descriptions for charts
settings.description: Adds text descriptions of charts, graphs and the map for screen readers.

settings.label: Announce saves and stage changes
settings.description: Tells screen readers when the case saves or a new stage opens.

settings.label: Avoid flashing effects
settings.description: Removes flashes and fast blinking anywhere in the program.

settings.label: Show shortcut hints on buttons
settings.description: Shows each button's keyboard shortcut on the button itself.

settings.label: Master volume
settings.description: The overall volume of every sound the program makes.

settings.label: Interface sounds
settings.description: Small clicks and tones when you use buttons and menus.

settings.label: Stage unlock chime
settings.description: Plays a chime when a new stage of a case opens.

settings.label: Warning sound
settings.description: Plays a tone when a training mode warning appears.

settings.label: Academy reward sounds
settings.description: Plays sounds when you earn XP, ranks and badges in the Academy.

settings.label: Mute when the window is not in focus
settings.description: Silences sounds while you are using another program.

settings.label: Sound pack
settings.description: The style of sounds: Quiet, Classic or Minimal.

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: Training gives hints and warnings before mistakes. Assessment gives neither and is the fairer test. This affects the score.

settings.label: Hints available
settings.description: How many hint levels you can ask for on each objective. Each hint costs a few marks. This affects the score.

settings.label: Procedural warnings
settings.description: In training mode, warns you once before a procedural mistake such as opening material outside your scope. This affects the score.
settings.note: On in training mode. Assessment mode never shows warnings.

settings.label: Show stage objectives
settings.description: Shows every objective, only the required ones, or keeps the list collapsed.

settings.label: Show stretch objectives
settings.description: Shows the optional stretch objectives that earn extra credit.

settings.label: Case clock
settings.description: Shows time worked on the case, time left against the case estimate, or hides the clock.

settings.label: Pause the clock when idle
settings.description: Stops counting time when you have not touched the program for a while.

settings.label: Highlight new evidence
settings.description: Marks items that arrived in the latest stage so they stand out in the list.

settings.label: Message from the case lead
settings.description: Shows case lead messages as a pop-up, in the brief panel, or both.

settings.label: Confirm before submitting a report
settings.description: Asks for confirmation before you submit, because submitting ends the attempt.

settings.label: Show running findings count
settings.description: Shows how many findings you have recorded on the Findings tab.

settings.label: Debrief detail
settings.description: Shows a short summary of your result, or the full debrief with every finding and event.

settings.label: Spoiler protection in the debrief
settings.description: Reveals the answers one key finding at a time, or all at once.

options.label: Reveal one finding at a time

settings.label: Allow retry after submission
settings.description: Lets you start a new attempt at a case you have already submitted.

settings.label: Rows per page
settings.description: How many rows a table shows before it splits into pages.

settings.label: Show row numbers
settings.description: Shows a number at the start of every table row.

settings.label: Highlight search matches
settings.description: Highlights search words inside documents and tables.

settings.label: Wrap long text
settings.description: Wraps long lines onto the next line instead of scrolling sideways.

settings.label: Default view for data files
settings.description: Opens data files such as CSV as a table or as raw text.

settings.label: Email header view
settings.description: Shows the main email headers, every header, or both.

settings.label: Message thread style
settings.description: Shows phone messages as chat bubbles or as a plain list.

settings.label: Image viewer zoom
settings.description: How images open: fitted to the window, at actual size, or filling the space.

settings.label: Image metadata panel
settings.description: Shows an image's metadata beside it all the time, or only when you ask.

settings.label: Hex preview for files
settings.description: Shows a byte-by-byte view of files, never, on request, or always.

settings.label: Open items in
settings.description: Opens evidence in tabs, or in a split view so you can compare two items.

settings.label: Remember scroll position
settings.description: Returns to where you were when you reopen an item.

settings.label: Show clock offset warnings
settings.description: Warns you when an item's clock is known to be fast, slow or in another time zone.

settings.label: Mark examined items
settings.description: Shows items you have examined with a tick, a faded row, or both.

settings.label: Default zoom
settings.description: How far in the timeline starts: a day, an hour, a minute, or everything at once.

settings.label: Group by
settings.description: Groups timeline events by person or thing, by source, or by type of evidence.

settings.label: Show source icons
settings.description: Shows a small icon for the kind of evidence behind each event.

settings.label: Highlight conflicts
settings.description: Highlights events from different sources that disagree about the time.

settings.label: Colour by confidence
settings.description: Colours events by how confident you are in them.

settings.label: Show gap markers
settings.description: Marks long gaps in the timeline where nothing is recorded.

settings.label: Sort order
settings.description: Lists events oldest first or newest first.

settings.label: Snap to grid
settings.description: Rounds events you add by hand to the nearest 5 minutes, 15 minutes or hour.

settings.label: Export image size
settings.description: The size of the picture made when you export the timeline as an image.

settings.label: Layout
settings.description: How the link chart arranges people and things: spread naturally, in a circle, as a hierarchy, or on a grid.

settings.label: Node size
settings.description: The size of each person or thing on the link chart.

settings.label: Labels
settings.description: When names appear on the link chart: always, on hover, or only for selected items.

settings.label: Edge style
settings.description: Draws links as straight lines or curves.

settings.label: Dashed lines for links without evidence
settings.description: Draws links with no cited evidence as dashed lines so they stand out.

settings.label: Show link strength
settings.description: Makes links thicker the more evidence supports them.

settings.label: Suggested links
settings.description: Whether the chart hints at connections the evidence might support.

settings.label: Cluster colouring
settings.description: Colours groups of closely linked items the same.

settings.label: Physics
settings.description: Lets the chart move and settle by itself. Turn off to keep items where you put them.

settings.label: Simplify the view above
settings.description: Hides labels and detail when the chart has more than this many items.

settings.label: Mini map
settings.description: Shows a small overview of the whole chart in a corner.

settings.label: Base map
settings.description: The background of the map: plain, with place labels, or with a grid.

settings.label: Distance units
settings.description: Shows distances in miles or kilometres.

settings.label: Show camera ranges
settings.description: Draws the area each camera covers.

settings.label: Show cell coverage circles
settings.description: Draws the rough area a phone mast covers. A phone could be anywhere inside it.

settings.label: Time slider speed
settings.description: How fast points move when you play the time slider.

settings.label: Trail length
settings.description: How much of a person's or thing's past movement stays on the map.

settings.label: Cluster nearby points
settings.description: Groups points that are close together into one marker until you zoom in.

settings.label: Show scale bar
settings.description: Shows a scale bar so you can judge distances.

settings.label: Layout
settings.description: Shows statements next to each other or one above another.

settings.label: Compare up to
settings.description: How many statements can be open side by side at once.

settings.label: Highlight colours
settings.description: The colours for agreeing and conflicting claims. Colour blind safe uses blue and orange.

settings.label: Show claim numbers
settings.description: Shows each claim's number, such as ST-2.3, beside it.

settings.label: Offer to send times and places to the timeline and map
settings.description: Shows buttons to send a claim's time to the timeline or its place to the map.

settings.label: Show running count of conflicts found
settings.description: Shows how many conflicts you have marked so far.

settings.label: Search mode
settings.description: Simple search takes plain words. Advanced adds filters for type, date, source and status.

settings.label: Case sensitive
settings.description: Treats capital and small letters as different when searching.

settings.label: Match whole words
settings.description: Only finds whole words, so 'van' does not match 'advance'.

settings.label: Include metadata in search
settings.description: Also searches item metadata such as authors, devices and headers.

settings.label: Fuzzy matching
settings.description: Finds near matches and small spelling mistakes.

settings.label: Search history length
settings.description: How many recent searches are remembered. Choose 0 to keep none.

settings.label: Remember filters between sessions
settings.description: Keeps your evidence list filters the next time you open the case.

settings.label: Result highlight colour
settings.description: The colour used to highlight search matches.

settings.label: Mock browser start page
settings.description: What the simulated web browser shows when you open it.

settings.label: Show page addresses
settings.description: Shows each page's web address in the address bar.

settings.label: Capture reminder
settings.description: Reminds you to capture a page properly before you rely on it.

settings.label: Hash captures automatically
settings.description: Every capture is hashed so it can be shown to be unchanged. This is always on.
settings.locked_reason: Captures are always hashed so they can be shown to be unchanged. Marking and the evidence trail depend on it.

settings.label: Show privacy badge on profiles
settings.description: Marks profiles as public or private so you know what your authority covers.

settings.label: Warn before opening a private profile
settings.description: Asks before opening a profile that is private.

settings.label: Clue overlays on images
settings.description: Lets you ask for highlights on parts of an image that might help locate it.

settings.label: Archive date style
settings.description: How dates on archived page copies are written.

settings.label: Action logging
settings.description: Every action you take is logged with the time. This is always on, because marking and the replay depend on it.
settings.locked_reason: Every action is always logged. The debrief, the replay and the marking are built from this log.

settings.label: Log detail
settings.description: How much detail the action log shows. Detailed includes every view and search.

settings.label: Hash display
settings.description: Shows hashes in full or shortened to the first characters.

settings.label: Verify hash when opening an original
settings.description: Checks an original item's hash each time you open it, only the first time, or never (training mode only).

settings.label: Warn about continuity gaps
settings.description: Warns if you examine an item before logging its receipt.

settings.label: Ask for a reason when opening originals
settings.description: Asks why you need an original rather than a working copy, always or only in training mode.

settings.label: Show custody timeline on items
settings.description: Shows each item's chain of custody as a timeline in the viewer.

settings.label: Template
settings.description: The layout of your report: Standard, a Short form, or Detailed.

settings.label: Citation style
settings.description: Cites evidence inline, such as (EV-012), or as footnotes.

settings.label: Check citations automatically
settings.description: Checks that every finding in the report cites evidence before you submit.

settings.label: Page size
settings.description: Paper size for PDF exports: A4 or Letter.

settings.label: Export font
settings.description: The typeface used in exported reports.

settings.label: Include evidence list appendix
settings.description: Adds a list of the evidence you relied on at the end of the report.

settings.label: Include link chart image
settings.description: Adds a picture of your link chart to the report.

settings.label: Include timeline image
settings.description: Adds a picture of your timeline to the report.

settings.label: Default export
settings.description: Which format the Export button makes first: PDF or Markdown.

settings.label: Spell check
settings.description: Underlines spelling mistakes while you write the report.

settings.label: Show word count
settings.description: Shows how many words each report section has.

settings.label: Draft autosave interval
settings.description: How often your report draft saves while you type.

settings.label: Replay speed
settings.description: How fast the investigation replay plays through your attempt.

settings.label: Replay detail
settings.description: Shows only the key moments, or every action you took.

settings.label: Show mistakes on the replay
settings.description: Marks traps and procedural mistakes on the replay track.

settings.label: Show suggested route
settings.description: Shows the case author's suggested route beside yours once the debrief is done.

settings.label: Start replay automatically
settings.description: Starts playing the replay as soon as you open it.

settings.label: Dashboard range
settings.description: How many recent attempts the skills dashboard uses.

settings.label: Dashboard chart style
settings.description: Shows your five skill areas as a radar chart or as bars.

settings.label: Best scores count assessment mode only
settings.description: Only counts assessment attempts for best scores, so training hints do not inflate them.

settings.label: Show suggested next steps
settings.description: Shows plain suggestions on what to practise next, with links to lessons.

settings.label: Reset progress history
settings.description: Clears the history behind the skills dashboard. Case saves are not touched.

settings.label: Default finding type
settings.description: The label a new finding starts with. Assumption is the safest default until you have evidence.

settings.label: Show grade fields on findings
settings.description: Shows the source and information grade fields on every finding, or only when evidence is linked.

settings.label: Link selected evidence to new findings
settings.description: Adds the item you are looking at as a citation when you start a new finding.

settings.label: Note font size
settings.description: The text size in the notes panel.

settings.label: Markdown preview in notes
settings.description: Shows formatted text, such as bold and lists, in your notes.

settings.label: Findings board layout
settings.description: Shows findings as a list, as cards, or grouped by stage.

settings.label: Autosave interval
settings.description: How often the case saves while you work.

settings.label: Autosave after key actions
settings.description: Also saves straight after important actions such as a request or a finding.

settings.label: Backup copies kept
settings.description: How many older copies of each save are kept, in case you need to go back.

settings.label: Backup folder
settings.description: Where backup copies are kept: the program's folder or a folder you choose.

settings.label: Save when closing
settings.description: Saves automatically when you close a case, or asks first.

settings.label: Export all saves
settings.description: Makes one file containing all your saves, to move to another computer.

settings.label: Import saves
settings.description: Brings in saves exported from another computer.

settings.label: Show storage used
settings.description: Shows how much space your cases, saves and settings take up.

settings.label: Clear caches
settings.description: Removes temporary files the program can rebuild. Saves are not touched.

settings.label: Delete all data
settings.description: Removes every case, save, setting and Academy record from this computer. Asks twice.

settings.label: Sort by
settings.description: The order cases appear in the library.

settings.label: View
settings.description: Shows cases as cards in a grid or as a list.

settings.label: Show difficulty badges
settings.description: Shows each case's difficulty, such as Beginner or Hard.

settings.label: Show time estimates
settings.description: Shows how long each case is expected to take.

settings.label: Show completed cases
settings.description: Keeps cases you have submitted in the library list.

settings.label: Confirm before removing a case
settings.description: Asks before a case and its saves are removed.

settings.label: Verify case packs
settings.description: Checks every case pack's hashes each time it opens, or only when the files have changed.

settings.label: Academy reminders
settings.description: Offers the matching lesson the first time you open a tool you have not learned yet.

settings.label: Tips frequency
settings.description: How often short tips appear while you work.

settings.label: Contextual help icons
settings.description: Shows small ? icons next to features that open the matching help article.

settings.label: 'What is this?' mode
settings.description: Allows the 'What is this?' mode, where you click any part of the screen for a short explanation.

settings.label: Open help in
settings.description: Opens the help centre in a side panel or in its own full window.

settings.label: Help search history
settings.description: How many recent help searches are remembered on this computer. Choose 0 to keep none.

settings.label: Show Academy rewards on profile
settings.description: Shows avatar frames and badge borders you have unlocked in the Academy.

settings.label: Reset Academy progress
settings.description: Clears your Academy XP, ranks and badges. Case saves are not touched.

settings.label: Shortcut preset
settings.description: A ready-made set of keyboard shortcuts: Default, Compact, or Mouse free for working without a mouse.

settings.label: Rebind actions
settings.description: Change the key for any of about 40 actions.

settings.label: Show shortcut sheet
settings.description: Shows every shortcut on one sheet you can print.

settings.label: Reset all shortcuts
settings.description: Puts every shortcut back to the default.

settings.label: Stage unlock banner
settings.description: Shows a banner when a new stage opens.

settings.label: Autosave notice
settings.description: How saving is shown: a small icon, a pop-up, or not at all.

settings.label: Hint available indicator
settings.description: Shows a small marker on objectives where a hint is available.

settings.label: Procedural warning style
settings.description: Shows training warnings as a dialog that must be answered or as a banner.

settings.label: Notification duration
settings.description: How long pop-up notices stay on screen.

settings.label: Content notice at case start
settings.description: Shows a short note about the case's themes before you start.

settings.label: Sensitive content warnings
settings.description: Shows a warning before items marked as sensitive.

settings.label: Blur images until opened
settings.description: Blurs images in previews until you choose to open them.

settings.label: Hide graphic details
settings.description: Hides graphic descriptions where a case offers a gentler version.

settings.label: Usage data collection
settings.description: Investafiction never sends anything off your computer. This cannot be changed because there is nothing to send.
settings.locked_reason: Investafiction never sends anything off your computer. There is nothing to switch on.

settings.label: Warn before opening packs from other authors
settings.description: Asks before importing a case pack that was not made by the starter pack authors.

settings.label: Case author mode
settings.description: For case authors: loads unpacked case folders and shows extra checks while you build a case.

options.label: On (loads unpacked case folders and shows extra checks)

settings.label: Show internal IDs on items
settings.description: Shows internal ids such as ENT-P1 next to names.

settings.label: Developer tools
settings.description: Enables the browser developer tools inside the program window.

settings.label: Log level
settings.description: How much the program writes to its own technical log.

settings.label: Experimental features
settings.description: Turns on features that are still being tested and may change.

settings.label: Open data folder
settings.description: Shows where your cases, saves and settings are kept on this computer.

settings.label: Export diagnostics
settings.description: Makes a local file with technical details for a bug report. It contains no case answers or personal data.
settings.note: Button. Makes a local file with no case answers or personal data

settings.label: Reset all settings
settings.description: Puts every setting back to its default. Saves and Academy progress are not touched.

presets.label: Recommended
presets.description: The defaults. A good balance for most people.

presets.label: Accessibility first
presets.description: Larger text, stronger contrast, less motion and bigger targets.

presets.label: Assessment style
presets.description: Hints and warnings off, as in a real test. New attempts start in assessment mode.
